note: Natural Earth 10 m (public domain), clipped to the table’s envelope, its splits at 180° merged (longitudes continuous, past 180 where they fall), simplified at 1500 m. Polygons: kind land (ne_10m_land), island (ne_10m_minor_islands), reef (the closed rings of ne_10m_reefs, which is a line layer); area in km² on the sphere, before simplification; outer rings counter-clockwise. strokes: ne_10m_coastline and ne_10m_minor_islands_coastline. reefs: every ne_10m_reefs line, open or closed.
